description:
Hi, I'm Miguel Cárdenas.

I spent decades working inside American homes, seeing the same energy mistakes cost families money month after month.

On Practical Home Energy, I show you where your home may be quietly wasting electricity, which appliances are costing you more than they should, and what to check before paying for an expensive repair, replacement, or “energy-saving” upgrade.

I was raised with a simple rule: don't waste what you worked hard to pay for.

Here you'll find practical advice on electric bills, heating, cooling, appliances, thermostats, hidden energy waste, and simple ways to make your home more efficient without falling for expensive gimmicks.

No scare tactics. No miracle gadgets. No unnecessary upgrades.

Just practical home energy advice that helps you keep more money in your pocket.

New videos every week.

Subscribe if you'd rather stop paying for wasted energy.
